department: Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Newark College of Engineering

deadline.value: The department page gives no application deadline.

gre_general.value: The electrical engineering PhD requires the GRE for all applicants, with minimum verbal above 150 and quantitative above 160.
gre_general.quote: Required for all applicants. The minimum GRE requirement for PhD Students: V>150, Q>160

also.quote: Newark College of Engineering - GRE optional but strongly recommended for all MS and PhD applicants

gre_subject.value: Electrical engineering has no GRE subject test.

toefl_min.value: The department asks for a TOEFL iBT minimum of 79 (550 paper, 213 computer).
toefl_min.quote: The minimum TOEFL score requirement is 79 (Internet Based), 550 (Paper Based) or 213 (Computer Based).

ielts_min.value: The department asks for an IELTS minimum of 6.5.

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The page does not state how many admitted students are funded.

entry_route.value: Applicants are expected to hold a master's degree in electrical engineering or a related field.
entry_route.quote: Applicants are expected to have a broad background in engineering, mathematics, physics and computer science as well as a Master of Science degree in electrical engineering or a related field.

notes: The computer engineering PhD (ece.njit.edu/phd-computer-engineering) is in the same department and allows superior students to enter directly from a bachelor's. Its rules were not recorded separately.
name: Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering
